---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "Single-level, panel, multilevel, and instrumental-variable systems"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The four examples at the end of the [help file](help.html), run in full.
Each combines two models of one family and then calls `margins` on the
combined system.

## Ordinary single-level models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
sysuse nlsw88, clear
logit union c.age i.married, vce(robust)
estimates store mod1
logit union c.age i.married i.collgrad, vce(robust)
estimates store mod2
suest2 mod1 mod2
margins, dydx(age married)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Panel models

Two fixed-effects regressions on the NLS panel, clustered on the panel
identifier:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse nlswork, clear
xtset idcode year
xtreg ln_wage c.ttl_exp##i.union i.year, fe
estimates store fe1
xtreg hours c.ttl_exp##i.union i.year, fe
estimates store fe2
quietly suest2 fe1 fe2, cluster(idcode)
suest2
margins, dydx(ttl_exp)
<</dd_do>>
```

Typing `suest2` on its own redisplays the table, as with any estimation
command.

## Mixed models

A random-intercept logit and probit for the same outcome, with the
model-specific predictions selected in `margins`:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse bangladesh, clear
melogit c_use urban age || district:, intpoints(5)
estimates store me1
meprobit c_use urban age || district:, intpoints(5)
estimates store me2
suest2 me1 me2
margins, dydx(age) predict(model(me1) mu fixedonly)
margins, dydx(age) predict(model(me2) mu conditional(fixedonly))
<</dd_do>>
```

## Instrumental variables

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse hsng2, clear
ivregress 2sls rent pcturban (hsngval = faminc)
estimates store iv1
ivregress 2sls rent pcturban (hsngval = faminc i.region)
estimates store iv2
suest2 iv1 iv2
margins, dydx(pcturban)
<</dd_do>>
```
